author: griffinlabs
description:
InternData-A1 dataset taken from InternRobotics/InternData-A1,
with the tarballs extracted and directory structure "transposed" so that the top-level subdirectories are the four embodiments.

	
		
	
	
		Two franka dirs
	

For the franka embodiment, there are two different feature spaces, so we split it into the franka-1 and franka-2 directories.
The feature spaces differ in image shape and gripper value range.

	
		
	
	
		Minor fixes
	

Some subsets such as… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/griffinlabs/InternData-A1-LeRobot-v3.0-by-embodiment.
